definition.en: Inflation reports and indices are systematic tools used to measure, track, and analyze the rate of change in price levels of goods and services within the Indian economy.
definition.hi: Inflation reports and indices are systematic tools used to measure, track, and analyze the rate of change in price levels of goods and services within the Indian economy.

importanceInUpsc.en: Understanding these indices is critical for UPSC GS-3 as they form the basis of monetary policy formulation by the RBI and fiscal policy adjustments by the government. Questions frequently appear on the methodology, components, and policy implications of indices like CPI and WPI.
